name: Scenario A: Normal Base Operations
description: 8 chargers, 300 kW site limit, 8 connected/waiting EVs under nominal grid conditions.

name: Scenario B: Peak Demand Congestion Surge
description: 15 arriving EVs competing for 300 kW transformer limit during evening commuter peak.

name: Scenario C: Utility Emergency Demand Response Event
description: Local grid issues a 150 kW load curtailment mandate. Station must protect mobility while shaving peak load.

name: Scenario D: High Battery Thermal Runaway Risk
description: Multiple EVs arrive with elevated battery temperatures (>42°C). Station enforces safe power envelopes.

name: Scenario E: Contextual Emergency Ambulance Preemption
description: Emergency service vehicle arrives with 12% SOC and urgent mission. Station preempts bay and compensates delayed users.
